# Jira Data Center Provider

Manages Jira Data Center projects and looks up the schemes they are built from. It authenticates with Basic Auth against REST API v2 and, for the operations that API does not expose, against custom ScriptRunner endpoints that must be deployed on the Jira instance beforehand. Jira Cloud is not supported.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    jira = {
      source  = "bra1nles5/jira-dc"
      version = "0.1.4"
    }
  }
}

provider "jira" {
  base_url = "https://jira.example.com/"

  # Both may be omitted when JIRA_USERNAME and JIRA_TOKEN are set.
  username = "admin"
  token    = "my-api-token"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `base_url` (String) Base URL of the Jira Data Center instance, for example https://jira.example.com

### Optional

- `token` (String, Sensitive) Jira API token. Can be set via the `JIRA_TOKEN` environment variable.
- `username` (String) Jira username for Basic Auth. Can be set via the JIRA_USERNAME environment variable.
